pins.title: Jacket on, then sit
pins.sub: You cool down fast the moment you stop. Pull on your warm layer first, then sit down for the view and the snack.

pins.title: Check the sunset time
pins.sub: Look up tonight's sunset for the trail, not your town. Plan to be back before it, and carry a headlamp anyway.

pins.title: Save it for the map
pins.sub: The light drains the battery you need for maps and calls. Carry a headlamp and a small power bank instead.

pins.title: All 63 parks, one page
pins.sub: A printable tracker with a beginner-friendly day hike for every US national park, stamp boxes and a visit log.

pins.title: Three layers that work
items: Base: wool or synthetic, no cotton
Plus a warm hat and gloves
pins.sub: Add and remove layers so you stay warm but never sweaty.

pins.title: Give a hike together
pins.sub: Printable coupons for hikes you'll take together: sunrise hike, picnic at the top, hot chocolate after. Instant PDF.

pins.title: Three printables, one gift
pins.sub: $15.99 instead of $18.97 bought separately. Instant PDF, so you can give it the same day.

pins.title: Small gear under $10
pins.sub: Useful on every hike, easy to wrap.

pins.title: When gaiters help
pins.sub: Pull them on over your laces before the trail turns messy.

pins.title: Free day in Utah's parks
items: Entry fees waived for US residents
Start early: free days get busy
pins.sub: Confirm the fee-free day and park alerts on nps.gov before you go.
